'our_eta_seconds' is Platterpus's smoothed album estimate; 'actual_remaining_seconds' is what really remained (finish − 'at') so estimate-vs-actual is directly visible; 'cyanrip_eta' is cyanrip's own per-op estimate (untrusted); 'read_speed' is the -S value in effect (0 = drive max); 'track'/'activity' are the event context for a jump; 'at' is the PC wall-clock time. 'state' names the branch that produced the sample — computed (a fresh rate measurement), held_no_rate / held_over_ceiling (the previous estimate re-shown), rereading (a secure re-read has the album bar pinned) or stalled (neither liveness signal moved) — so a held value is never mistaken for a measurement; 'reread_pass' counts restarts of the current track's read (0 = first read). Compare against 'timing'.
